gloss: extreme heat; severe heat; scorching weather

definitions.gloss: extreme heat; severe heat; scorching summer weather
definitions.explanation: extremely hot weather conditions, more severe than ordinary summer heat; often used when temperatures significantly exceed normal levels

examples.japanese: {今年|ことし}は{例年|れいねん}にない{酷暑|こくしょ}だ。
examples.english: This year is experiencing unprecedented extreme heat.

examples.japanese: {酷暑|こくしょ}で{農作物|のうさくもつ}に{被害|ひがい}が{出|で}た。
examples.english: The extreme heat has damaged crops.

examples.japanese: {酷暑|こくしょ}の{中|なか}、エアコンなしでは{過|す}ごせない。
examples.english: In this extreme heat, I can't survive without air conditioning.

notes:
FORMATION:
{酷|こく} (severe, cruel) + {暑|しょ} (heat) → severe heat

INTENSITY SCALE (from less to more severe):
- {暑|あつ}さ (heat - general)
- {猛暑|もうしょ} (intense heat - 35°C+)
- {酷暑|こくしょ} (extreme/severe heat)
- {炎暑|えんしょ} (scorching heat - literary)

USAGE:
{酷暑|こくしょ} is slightly more formal and emphatic than {猛暑|もうしょ}. It emphasizes the cruel, unbearable nature of the heat.

RELATED TERMS:
- {猛暑|もうしょ} (intense heat)
- {猛暑日|もうしょび} (day over 35°C)
- {熱中症|ねっちゅうしょう} (heatstroke)
- {厳冬|げんとう} (severe winter - opposite season)

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {酷暑|こくしょ}の{夏|なつ} (summer of extreme heat)
- {酷暑|こくしょ}が{続|つづ}く (extreme heat continues)
- {酷暑|こくしょ}を{乗|の}り{切|き}る (to get through the extreme heat)
